`difflib.unified_diff(a, b, fromfile='', tofile='', ...)` compares two lists of strings and returns a generator of delta lines in unified diff format. In `re`, `re.IGNORECASE` (short form `re.I`) enables case-insensitive matching, so a pattern like `[A-Z]` also matches lowercase letters.
